thesis: Episodes, representations and interpreter libraries retain different things; transfer depends on applicability contracts and preserved provenance.

ideas.statement: Episodes, representations and interpreter libraries retain different things; transfer depends on applicability contracts and preserved provenance.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A last-event rule transfers between permission and preference but not to cumulative bank balances.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Retirement must preserve old results; low-frequency capabilities matter and source repetition is not independent evidence.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
